articles.summary: JERICHO, NY / ACCESS Newswire / March 18, 2025 / Intelligent Protection Management Corp. ("IPM," the "Company," "we," "our" or "us") (Nasdaq:IPM), a managed technology solutions provider focused on cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure, today announced that it has rescheduled its fourth quarter and year end 2024 earnings results conference call to Monday, March 24, 2025 at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time.
